_comment: Metadata policy per document role. Data, not code: the ingestion API validates uploads against this file, the UI renders the form from it (GET /api/v1/metadata/document-roles), and a new role or a changed requirement is a change here. Disciplines are never listed here: discipline is free text and new disciplines work without any code change.

roles.label: Institutional curriculum (the one analysed)
roles.description: A programme curriculum of an institution; the analysis compares it with industry demand and with reference and peer curricula.

roles.label: Earlier version of the institutional curriculum
roles.description: An older version of the same programme, used for curriculum drift.

roles.label: Peer curriculum
roles.description: An official curriculum of another institution, used only for peer comparison; never mixed into the target's analytics.

roles.label: Reference curriculum
roles.description: A model or regulatory curriculum (e.g. from a national body). It may not belong to one institution: 'institution' holds the issuing body when there is one.

roles.label: General taxonomy or reference document
roles.description: A taxonomy, framework or reference text that is not a curriculum. Registered as a source with provenance; not run through curriculum extraction.

fields.programme: Programme (e.g. the degree programme's name as written by the institution)
fields.discipline: Discipline or branch -- free text; any discipline is accepted
fields.specialization: Specialization, if the programme has one
fields.degree_level: Degree level (e.g. undergraduate, postgraduate, diploma) -- free text
fields.academic_year: Academic year the curriculum applies from
fields.curriculum_version: Curriculum version or regulation as named in the document
fields.document_role: What this document is for in the analysis
fields.source_url: Where the official document was obtained
fields.licence_note: Licence or terms of use as stated by the source
fields.title: Document title
